text:
alex: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for last week's GPU saturation. We need clear remediation owners + timelines. I started a short doc but want us to agree on owners here.

morgan: I can own the scheduler tuning items. Will propose param changes and a test plan by EOD Wed.

jia: I'll own the quota request to cloud. Plan to submit ticket by Fri 10:00. Also saw recurring spikes Tue/Thu ~03:00 UTC — flagging pattern.

sam: I'll take headroom planning (simulate 95th/99th tails and recommend buffer). Deliverable: headroom plan + Dedicated pool RBAC outline by next Tue EOD.

taylor: I'll handle on-call review and ops board tracking (create a card with patterns + owners). Need a small list of preemptible jobs to evict — can someone share?

alex: Assignments: scheduler diffs -> @morgan, quota ticket -> @jia, headroom sims -> @sam, ops board & on-call review -> @taylor. Please include target deadlines in your updates. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall-bot: Incident linked: INC-2025-4412 — GPU saturation triggered fallback routing at 2025-11-18T03:12:47Z.

morgan: Proposed quick autoscaler patch to test in perf env: ```yaml
clusterAutoscaler:
  scaleDown: false
  maxNodesPerPool: 20
  bufferPct: 0.18
  cooldownSec: 120
``` Will open PR and tests.

jia: Drafted quota request: "Increase GPU quota in us-west-2 by 30 for 90 days to validate headroom model." Submitting now — ticket CZ-9813. Adding cost estimate.

sam: Ran sims with +30 GPUs and 18% buffer: 95th tail latency reduces ~22%. Pushed spreadsheet to the doc (link). Will paste summary into the postmortem.

taylor: Created ops board card: "GPU-capacity-recurring-patterns" and tagged owners. Added CI job list for potential preemption.

alex: Recap (owners + deadlines): morgan — scheduler PR Wed EOD; jia — quota ticket submitted Fri 10:00; sam — headroom plan Tue EOD; taylor — ops card + on-call review Mon. I'll follow up on Friday to close gaps.

morgan: Will need a kernel bump approved by infra for the new scheduler tunables. Ping @devops-eng when PR is ready.

jia: Cloud asked for a rollback plan and cost delta — attaching estimate to CZ-9813.

sam: If sims look good, propose a canary in small region on Thu 02:00 UTC low-traffic window.

alex: Canary confirmed Thu 02:00 UTC. Rollback plan: immediate revert of autoscaler config and route traffic to smaller model shards.

taylor: Adding weekly follow-up checklist to ops board so this doesn't slip. Setting reminder to check owners' status next Fri.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll update the postmortem follow-up section with these owners + deadlines and ping again if anything slips.
